notes.title: Build 2.04
notes.notes: [p][u]Features that help you survive[/u][/p][olist][*][p]Vehicle[/p][p]You can repair broken cars and refuel them to use them for travel.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/1c2901b5611cceb20e2e85da540854f82cccb174.png"][/img]"Repair Car"[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/375fc5ae505abadd472b9b2cd21375d1ba0322f9.png"][/img]"Refuel"[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Survival Behavior[/p][p]If the survivors in your city are destroyed, they will try to survive by running away and gathering at the city center (Anchor or green ball) to make them feel safe from danger.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/33f4e4faf362040ff0ca91a12131c387fa6c4000.png"][/img]"Survivors will run away from any threat to the city center"[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Protective Objects[/p][p]Even if survivors manage to converge in the city center, zombies can still attack them. We can use wood to build a wooden wall to protect our people from the zombies.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/328d2f61b139cbff4bf70385760b0d0f4cce9b98.png"][/img]"Installing wooden walls to provide additional protection to the building"[/p][/*][*][p]Resource[/p][p]In addition to finding resources inside buildings, outside the city, you'll find various resources, including herbs for medicine, wood for construction, and apples for food. You just have to go out and search for them.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/1ed54a137471ba932a98abd7bb3cfd2558a455f2.png"][/img]"Herb resource"  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/e6b0c202c76f13ce23394b0de4b8e2375516f7b3.png"][/img]"Woods Resource"[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Victims and Bandits[/p][p]In the world of "ZombiGON", there are still many survivors, both victims and bandits. If you find a victim and help them, you will gain additional leadership points, which will allow you to recruit more people to help you (or join your party).  But if you meet a bandit , they are ready to harm you at any time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/54a620fe7f77a516cf787a6e67d0cd64eae49aa4.png"][/img]"Victim"[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/64c0f19aafafe6596ea4a81e4e525d20db58408f.png"][/img]"Bandit" Please notice all bandits they have a name over their head.[/p][/*][/olist][p][u]Features that threat you[/u][/p][olist][*][p]Bad weather[/p][p]When the bad weather conditions from heavy rain affect your survival, the flamethrower that we use to deal with zombies will not work when it rains, or if you stay in the rain for a long time, you will get sick.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/57f17d2079537aba57ade1e8f45542b51b150325.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Infection[/p][p]Rats are another threat you will face. Once you take over a city from the zombies, you will start gathering food. Then, rats will flock to your city. What can you do? They are hungry. They are just small rats. They will bite you in small wounds. But those wounds can get you infected and even die if you don't treat them.[/p][/*][*][p]Bandits[/p][/*][*][p]Survivors morale[/p][p]Every survivor needs food, medicine, shelter, and safety. If you can't provide these things, they will run away from you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/9cfa5865221af54ccf4ed932e75e46260355ed4a.png"][/img]"Survivor States. MR is morale"[/p][/*][/olist][p][u]Others[/u][/p][p]As ZombiGON is an open-world survival game, we have a map for your convenience. As you explore the world and discover things, they are recorded on the map so you can return to them later.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/eb933db37a15246fc1ccaf2f0d9b76e58ceae959.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="-TI09nL-QRk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Enjoy!!![/p][p]WIK Games Studio.[/p]

notes.title: Build 2.03
notes.notes:
[u]1. RAT PLAGUE[/u]
When you retake your city from the zombies, in addition to random zombie hordes attacking you and bandits invading your city, there will also be hungry rats that will wreak havoc on you.
At first, only a few rats will enter your town. But if one steals your food, it will travel back to its nest and return with 300-400 of its mates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/4b42e8aa93ad0d3d71bf0c9e68484ece7bc15702.png[/img]


If you can't get rid of just the rats that steal your food before they return to their nest, you're up against 300-400 more rats.


[previewyoutube=eODc2W-Rehw;full][/previewyoutube]


[u]2. SURVIVORS INFORMATION[/u]
A UI has been added to make it easier for players to know the information of the Survivors they are following. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/e7197013826906b5ff4bf40b38db75ea1ae38448.png[/img]

Simply press the "P" button to see the Survivor's health, stamina, hunger, sleep, morale, and skills.


[previewyoutube=KBNsDvFbMYQ;full][/previewyoutube]



[b]Remark[/b]
In the future, we will add more Game characteristics from Survivors' clothing , decoration in the city and skills, increasing Survivors' morale and gameplay impact.


[b]Enjoys !!!
WIK Games Studio[/b]

notes.title: Build 2.02
notes.notes:
[u]1. FACILITIES[/u]
We have added a city facilities system to make it more convenient for players. When players retake a city and there are many survivors in the city, food and medicine are essential. 
You can assign friends who have cooking skills to buildings that act as markets, restaurants or cafes. Every day, your friend will prepare and distribute food to the people in your community, but you must have the ingredients he needs ready. 
In the Hospital building, you can assign friends with the Medical skill to use the Hospital building to treat people in your community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/87ff48aeaa63b9846cf777726f5f9a90d68ab858.jpg[/img]

[u]2. CITY MAP and WORLD MAP[/u]
For the convenience of the players, the game has a [b]world map[/b] that shows the location of the cities in the game and a [b]city map[/b] that shows the location of the buildings in the game, making it easy when you explore different points in the [b]"ZombiGON"[/b] game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/bfa9b5650bb81d05a68c5c09450ccfbb0961ab63.png[/img]

[u]3. BANDITS[/u]
After the zombie apocalypse, some survivors turned into bandits. Some of these bandits are not cruel, they just want food. They will steal food from you and leave. 
But some of them turned out to be psychopaths, thinking of killing everyone who survived. You should notice the names on the heads of these bandits. It can indicate the level of brutality of the  bandit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/735b154c9e81d92f1003cc79a6c08fbd28b275e5.png[/img]

[u]4. FLOATING SIGN[/u]
When something happens in the game, such as a survivor following you is dissatisfied with you, or a death occurs in the city, the game will have a floating icon on the screen to let you know that something has happened.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/ae7823281b723c16049966eaf0282199c8cbc56a.png[/img]

[b]We hope you enjoy our game. We will continue to improve our game to make it more fun. Thank you.[/b]

WIK Games Studio

notes.title: ZombiGON survival mode
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=BcLeNpKWPME;full][/previewyoutube]

ZombiGON survival mode How to play from Battle mode has been added as follows.
1. [u]Focus on building community[/u]
Each survivor you save He will have abilities or skills. Those skills will help your community survive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/02054b8580704b8bce858a0a76ae13eab36152ab.jpg[/img]

The skills

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/1419d2ff877a9825fa2b931696517da31b43eb44.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/4136b6521f0d467d012fdc52105a3dbdfec56dd8.jpg[/img]

Some skills can create materials, food, or objects when you're camping or anchoring or after reclaiming cities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/b45f4d7cb1b9e59f8e6ef02f184c2bc606af46d5.png[/img]

2. [u]Reclaim back the cities from the Zombies[/u]
If there are no more zombies in the city, if you press the V button, an anchor will appear. When you click, you will take back the city from the zombies.

If you can reclaim back the city from zombies. You will be able to use various resources. within the city in order to survive

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/e4949c954df67e0c8c47cca7852d661f45aaee50.jpg[/img]

3. [u]Protect the city from the zombie invasion[/u].
Once you have taken back the city from the zombies. not long after Hordes of zombies will start attacking your city. You must find a way to keep your anchor impervious to the zombies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/3b675de1d29dcf9afacbcc5f6d91e71882d830c0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/2ffb5494e7c76899bffb6542bdca64b9947ea492.png[/img]

4. Share all resources to your members.
All survivor they all need food, shelter, medicine, and safety. If you can provide these things to the survivors, He will agree to help you fight the zombies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127085/e763edfe8cc08c4acfa17400bf17a5eba0ec442f.png[/img]


Good Luck and survive
Thanks you
WIK Games Studio.

[b]P.S. I will provide the manual to explain how to play as soon as possible.
[/b]

We are in the process of improving the quality of the game.

[u]Human NPCs [/u]
In the world of "ZombiGON", it's not just you and zombies anymore, there are people who have to escape death from zombies as well.

The harbor is full of people. What will you do? When the people in the port turned into zombies
